upload.title: Receipts become a spreadsheet.
upload.description: Drop your Pix, wire transfer or boleto receipts below. Fields are extracted on your machine, you review what was read and export the spreadsheet. No file is uploaded anywhere.
upload.dropDescription: or click to browse — PDF, PNG, JPG or WEBP
upload.step1Text: Bank PDF or a photo/screenshot. Several at once.
upload.step2Text: Pix, wire transfers and boletos are detected automatically.
upload.step3Text: Review what was read and export as .xlsx or .csv.

review.title: Review and export
review.description: Check the extracted fields and fix anything you need before generating the spreadsheet.
review.tableHint: Highlighted cells are empty. Click any field to edit, or the eye to see the original receipt.
review.waitingDescription: Fields show up here as soon as reading finishes.
review.addMoreDescription: Drag or click — they join the same spreadsheet

history.title: Recent spreadsheets
history.description: The last 3 exports are stored in this browser and can be downloaded again in any format.
history.emptyDescription: Once you export, it shows up here.
